bodySchema.description: Payload required to create a new Element (Asset)

nfc_code.description:
Optional NFC code for the Element.
When available, it can help to quickly identify the Element.

bar_code.description:
Optional bar code for the Element.
When available, it can help to quickly identify the Element.

latitude.description:
Optional geographic latitude coordinate for the Element's precise location.
Essential for visualizing where the Element is on the map.
- Required when longitude is filled

longitude.description:
Optional geographic longitude coordinate for the Element's precise location.
Essential for visualizing where the Element is on the map.
- Required when latitude is filled

observation.description: Optional notes, remarks, or additional descriptive information about the Element.

code.description:
Optional code for the Element within its context (e.g., within the Entity or Category).
Useful for quick reference or integration purposes.

category_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Category.
- Must reference a Category from `GET /categories/all`.
- The Category must be of type "TYPE_OF_EQUIPMENT". Categories of type "SOFT_MAINTENANCE" are NOT allowed.

local_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Location (where the Element is situated).
- Must reference a Location from `GET /locations`.
- The Location must be of type "location". Locations of type "building" or "location-folder" are NOT allowed.

maintenance_policy_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Maintenance Policy.
- Must reference a Maintenance Policy from `GET /maintenance-policies`.
- The Maintenance Policy must belong to the same Category specified in `category_id`.

acquisition_cost.description:
Optional acquisition Cost of the element. Required with:
- lifetime
- residual_value

acquisition_date.description:
Optional date (and time) when the Element was acquired (or put into service).
Uses ISO 8601 `date-time` format.

supplier_name.description: Optional name of the vendor or supplier from whom the Element was acquired.

lifetime.description:
Optional expected useful lifetime of the Element in years.
Used for depreciation or replacement planning.
For this field, `acquisition_cost` is required.

residual_value.description:
Optional estimated residual or salvage value of the Element at the end of its useful lifetime.
For this field, `acquisition_cost` is required.

stoppage_cost.description: Optional estimated cost incurred of downtime if this Element fails or stops working.

element_uuid.description:
Optional universal unique identifier (UUID) supplied by the client for the element.
If omitted, the server generates a creation time.
Providing a UUID can support idempotent creation patterns. Allowing offline creation (such as from the mobile app).

problem_id.description: ID of the associated problem. Refers to the type of Problem and need to be a Problem Type, not a Problem Area. To get the Problem Types, first, you need to retrieve the Problem Areas (GET `/problems`). Then, list the Problem Types from the desired area (GET `/problems/{problem_id}/subproblems`) and, from the response, use the respective `problem_id`.

description.description: A more detailed description of the reported incident.

observations.description: A longer description or anything with longer text that needs to be reported.

priority.description: Failure priority number, being 1 the lowest priority and 4 the highest priority.

client_id.description: ID of the client associated to the Failure

local_id.description: ID of the location associated to the Failure

operator_id.description: ID of the operator that owns the Failure. By default, uses the ID of the Operator associated to the API token.

report_type.description: Type of the Failure's reporter. The failure can be reported by an Operator or by a Contact.

report_id.description: ID of the operator or contact who reported the Failure

supplier_id.description: ID of the supplier associated to the Failure

include_automatic_assignees.description: If is to append automatic assignees when a user select a custom list of assignees

enforce_nfc.description:
Whether the asset's NFC tag must be scanned to execute the tasks of this work order.
Only administrators and managers decide this field. A value sent by any other role is ignored rather than rejected.
What is stored depends on the entity's `enforce-nfc` extension. With it configured as required, a value sent by an administrator or a manager is honoured and omitting the field stores `true`. Otherwise the field is ignored and the work order is created with `false`.

To get the Problem Types, first, you need to retrieve the Problem Areas (GET `/problems`). Then, list the Problem Types from the desired area (GET `/problems/{problem_id}/subproblems`) and, from the response, use the respective `problem_id`.

name.description: The name (or description) of the Other Cost

input_type.description: The type of Other Cost. Different types of Other Costs have different associated fields. Other Costs of type resource will measure its total cost based on how long (e.g. hours, minutes) the resource is occupied. Other Costs of type distance will measure its total cost based on how many units (e.g. meters, kilometers) are needed. Other Costs of type interval and time_range will measure its total cost based on duration. Other Costs of type currency will have a fixed cost manually defined for each operation. Other Costs of type custom_unit_of_measurement will measure its total cost based on how many units (e.g. m3, liters) are needed.

icon.description: The icon to be presented for the Other Cost in Infraspeak platform.

failure.description: Indicates if the Other Cost can be included in costs for Corrective Maintenance (Work Orders).

schedule_work.description: Indicates if the Other Cost can be included in costs for Preventive Maintenance (Planned Job Orders).

operator.description: Indicates if the Other Cost can be included in individual costs for operators (technicians)

element.description: Indicates if the Other Cost can be included in costs for Assets

cost_per_unit.description: Cost per unit of the Other Cost. Only applicable if input_type is "resource", "distance" or "custom_unit_of_measurement"

default_sell_price.description: Default sell price of the Other Cost.  Only applicable if input_type is "resource", "distance" or "custom_unit_of_measurement"

default_sell_vat.description: Default sale VAT/IVA percentage of the Other Cost. Only applicable if input_type is "resource", "distance" or "custom_unit_of_measurement"

unit.description: Unit of the Other Cost. Only applicable if input_type is "resource", "distance" or "custom_unit_of_measurement"
